description: Attach a metafield (custom typed field) to a resource (shop, product, variant, customer, order, collection, draft_order, etc).

metafield.description: Shopify metafield object. Required: namespace, key, value, type (e.g. 'single_line_text_field', 'number_integer', 'json', 'boolean'). Optional: owner_resource ('product' | 'variant' | 'customer' | 'order' | 'collection' | ...), owner_id, description. Omit owner_* to attach to shop.

name: create_metafield
